name: video-blur-vignette
title: Video Blur Vignette
description: An autoplaying, muted forest video fills a rounded frame whose edges blur and fade into the page. The centre stays sharp, and the footage zooms slightly when hovered.
use: You want looping footage to blend into a dark page instead of sitting in a hard-edged box.
avoid: It relies on a remote MP4, so the frame stays empty if that host is blocked or offline.
a11y: The clip loops with no pause control and no captions, and it ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded rectangle showing sunlit tall trees, a mossy trunk at the left and green ferns below, spanning nearly the full width on a black page. The outer band of the footage is soft and slightly dimmed, so the frame melts into the background.
behaves: The muted forest clip loops on its own from the moment it loads. Hovering zooms the footage in a little; otherwise the only change is the drifting sunlight and foliage as the video plays.
customise: The video source URL and its classes are written into the component, so swap the MP4 there. Radius, inset, fade length and blur come from the vignette wrapper props.
weight: moderate: Backdrop blur is recomputed over a looping video on every frame.
